contract: Stateless request/result identity correlation and named reply-wrapper validation over core/envelope; results pass through unchanged.
limits: No pending/completed table, duplicate suppression, dispatch, timeout evaluation, classification or multi-attempt tracking.
No payload validation, durability or exactly-once guarantee.

grounding.claim: Pinned Cure compilation checks pure correlation and reply-wrapper decisions over existing Envelope records; no quantified proof.
Named positive/error-order, unchanged outcome, Option identity and source-audit scenarios; finite tests, not universal proof.
Relies on pinned Cure type checking, structural equality and String/Option/Result/record erasure; compiler soundness is not locally proved.
Callers supply truthful identities and dispatch observations, validate payloads and own ingress limits and runtime effects.

telemetry.contract: Pure checks emit no observations; invoking Unit/Assembly owns instrumentation.

config.contract: Intrinsic message data only; no ambient settings or hot reconfiguration.

control.contract: No lifecycle, dispatch or operational commands.
